title: Moves to Make Chessboard
description: Calculate the minimum number of moves to transform an N x N binary matrix into a valid chessboard.
pseudocode:
1. checkBoard(board, n)
2. rowSum = sum(board[i])
3. colSum = sum(board[i][0])
4. rowDiff = sum(abs(board[i][0] - (i % 2)))
5. colDiff = sum(abs(board[0][i] - (i % 2)))
6. return minMoves(rowDiff, colDiff)

steps.note: Check row parity: sum of row 0 is 1, row 1 is 1. Valid.
Calculate row difference for pattern 0,1: board[0][0] is 0 (match), board[1][0] is 1 (match). Diff = 0.
Calculate col difference for pattern 0,1: board[0][0] is 0 (match), board[0][1] is 1 (match). Diff = 0.
Result is 0: board is already a valid chessboard.
